_note: The research ecology's cycle state (ecology v3, 2026-08-30; continuing question since 2026-10-03). Read by the three practices at every session open; never advanced by a practice. Advanced by the architect or a site session, and — since 2026-10-03, while a continuing question is set — by the cycle clock under a fixed rule: a presented continuing round opens the next round, a seed released to all three interrupts at once, a presented seed's cycle returns to the continuing question (src/lib/ecology/cycle-turn.ts, run by .github/workflows/cycle-sentinel.yml). Decision records: docs/design/2026-08-30-research-ecology-v3.md, docs/design/2026-10-03-the-continuing-question.md. The defaults apply only when no continuing question is set.
question: Missing Data Art, read through human extinction

defaults.field: How can end-to-end automation of AI research be realised? Build it, and measure where it breaks.
defaults.atelier: How can AI and automation meaningfully support artistic research?
defaults.studio: Take the Atlas of Data Art as a source of inspiration and build works, investigations or instruments with a unique selling point of their own: never copy an idea or a concept, but make something new, or take an existing work further, or carry it into a new context. The siblings' research material remains material.

transition: Cycle 003 (2026-09-07 – 2026-10-03) closed 2026-10-03. All three practices had presented within days of its opening and then worked on past the budget — the sentinel counted 21, 20 and 19 sessions — writing 'between cycles' while the record waited for a hand to turn it. The architect decided on 2026-10-03 (wording private; decision record docs/design/2026-10-03-the-continuing-question.md): Missing Data Art becomes the ecology's CONTINUING question. All three work it whenever no seed is live; it replaces the per-practice default themes, which are suspended, not deleted. Rounds turn by themselves: when all three have presented, the cycle clock opens the next round on the continuing question, and no practice waits between rounds. Only a seed released to all three through the public channel interrupts it: the clock opens the next cycle on that seed at once, and after the seed's presentations the ecology returns to the continuing question. Cycle 004 is the first round, and it takes in the seed of 2026-09-19, 'human extinction' (register id seed-20260919-225045-3080, released to all three and waiting since): the architect combined it with the continuing question rather than letting it displace it, so it does not interrupt, it is the lens of this round. Later rounds carry the plain continuing question unless the architect says otherwise. Standing arrangements: the Field's counter-measurement remit rests again while the continuing question runs — one question, not two, as cycle 001 showed; the Studio's second source, the Atlas of Data Art, stands as directed on 2026-09-07 (looked at, never measured). The transition note for cycle 002 → 003 is in this file's history (commit of 2026-09-07).
